intro.title: Tab-Based App Shell
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a mobile app with a tab-based navigation shell using Ionic and Angular. You will learn how to structure an app with multiple views accessible via bottom tabs. The core concept is using Ionic's tab components and Angular routing to manage different sections of the app. You will work with Ionic's UI components, Angular modules, and Capacitor for native mobile features. By the end, you'll have a functional app shell that users can navigate by tapping on tabs.
intro.usecase: Tab-based navigation is a fundamental pattern in mobile apps where users need to switch between distinct functional areas quickly. You'll see this in apps like Instagram (Home, Search, Reels, Activity, Profile), banking apps (Accounts, Transfers, Payments, Support), and productivity tools like Slack (Chats, Channels, Mentions, You). As a developer, implementing a tab shell with Ionic provides the foundation for organizing complex app functionality into intuitive sections while maintaining smooth navigation transitions and consistent UI patterns across platforms.
